voices.name: Pari M - Relatable Hindi Friend
voices.description: Warm, natural & genuinely easy to talk to, Pari M brings the kind of relatable Hindi energy that makes every conversation feel like catching up with a close friend. Her casual, unscripted delivery works across companion apps, everyday dialogue, casual AI chat, and conversational platforms where an authentic, friendly presence makes users feel instantly at ease. Perfect for Hindi companion apps, conversational AI platforms, and consumer brands across Tier 1 and Tier 2 INDIA.

voices.name: Pari M – Regional Bank Support
voices.description: Pari M brings a raw, sweet, and naturally helpful tone to banking customer care. Her voice feels close and familiar — the kind that Tier 2 and Tier 3 customers trust without hesitation. Not overly polished, but always respectful and clear. Ideal for PSU banks, small finance banks, cooperative banks, rural fintech platforms, and Jan Dhan-linked services reaching customers across smaller cities and towns across India.

voices.name: Paris - Narrator, Warm and Tender
voices.description: A mesmerizing voice that lulls listeners into your story. Slight exotic Asian accent, soothing yet haunting—perfect for narrations, audiobooks, ASMR, and meditations. Let my voice captivate your audience.

voices.name: Hari - Engaging
voices.description: A clear, articulate, and academic speaking style with a measured, informative delivery, ideal for lectures, educational content, and explaining mathematical concepts in economics and finance.

voices.name: Mari - Mexican Commercial Voice-Over Artist
voices.description: Female voice with a Mexican Spanish accent—clear and natural—ideal for radio and TV commercials, social media ads, promotional spots, and brand messaging.

voices.name: Adrian Park - Warm, Deep, Recovered
voices.description: This voice envelops the room like a soft, warm blanket. It sounds warm, deep, and recovered - as familiar as the gentle crackling of a fireplace on a snowy evening. With soft, unhurried pauses, he allows each word to breathe, effortlessly transporting his listeners to a distant, wondrous world. A quiet sense of wonder resonates in his tone, awakening even the imaginations of adults and allowing them to forget the everyday world for a moment.

voices.name: Park Hyoil - Versatile
voices.description: This is a smooth, versatile voice suitable for a wide range of uses—such as voiceovers for news or YouTube content, economic commentary, storytelling, sports announcing, or the tone of a friendly teacher.

voices.name: Dorian - Parisian
voices.description: A natural and expressive French male voice with a conversational, confident and approachable delivery. Authentic and engaging, with fluid pacing and subtle variations in tone. Ideal for podcasts, storytelling, AI assistants, educational content, professional presentations and everyday conversations. A modern French voice designed to sound human, spontaneous and relatable, without the overly polished feel of traditional voiceovers.

voices.name: Omid - Afghan Dari Narrator
voices.description: Authentic Afghan Dari male voice with natural Afghan pronunciation and a warm, clear and friendly tone. Ideal for storytelling, audiobooks, documentaries, educational content, voiceovers and everyday conversations. A genuine Afghan Dari speaking style.

voices.name: Lari Diniz - Ads
voices.description: Female voice for advertisements and lively narrations.
